description: La Chaux-de-Fonds is the watchmaking town of parallel streets and even cornice lines, seen from the outside along Avenue Léopold-Robert. Pale 19th-century facades run straight toward the Jura ridges at the end of the high valley. No factory interior and no watch brand appear, and at about 1000 metres in late September the street is free of winter snow. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast, with no rain.
